text:
Someone can change your opening hours on Google without asking you.

When Google flags a suggested edit, you get 4 days to reject it.

Miss that email and it may go live anyway.

Who actually checks the inbox your Google Business Profile is set up on?

"We get plenty of Facebook leads. They just never pick up the phone."

The leads aren't the problem. The gap between the form and the booking is.

Facebook lead ads can now let people pick a time right after the form:
https://gimsresults.com.au/post/facebook-lead-ads-appointment-booking

Google Ads went weird in September?

More clicks. Fewer calls. Strange search terms.

Many Search campaigns were auto-upgraded to AI Max from Sept 1. If yours had broad match or auto-created assets switched on, check your search terms this week.

Nobody googles your staff Christmas party.

They google problems.

"How much does a new roof cost in Perth?"
"Do I need council approval for a deck?"

Answer those on your website and the right people find you.

Can a new business beat older competitors on Google?

Yes.

Being around longer isn't the advantage people think it is. Being the most useful answer to what customers search for is.

https://gimsresults.com.au/post/can-new-businesses-rank-on-google

More people are asking AI tools for "a good electrician near me".

Those answers still lean on the basics: your website, your Google Business Profile, your reviews.

Good SEO is how you show up in AI answers too.
